MKSDC.App.Title: Shadowdark Crafting
MKSDC.App.NoActor: Select a token or assign a character to open crafting.
MKSDC.App.NoRecipesGMHint: Create a recipe from this panel, or run window.mkShadowdarkCrafting.createSampleRecipes() as GM.
MKSDC.Editor.Title: Crafting Recipe Editor
MKSDC.Editor.MaterialsHint: Each requirement row can contain one or more substitute materials. Drop an item on the main box to create a new requirement row, or drop it inside an existing row to add it as an alternative. A recipe requires every row, but only one alternative from each row.
MKSDC.Notes.CriticalSuccess: Critical success: the work is exceptional.
MKSDC.Notes.CriticalFailure: Critical failure: the work is ruined and a complication may occur.
MKSDC.Notes.MaterialsLost: Some materials were lost during the attempt.
MKSDC.Notes.MaterialConsumptionFailed: Could not consume {name}; {remaining} still needed. The output was not created.
MKSDC.Notes.GoldConsumptionFailed: Could not consume the full gold cost; {remaining} still needed. The output was not created.
MKSDC.Notes.OutputNotCreated: No crafted item was created because resource consumption did not complete.
MKSDC.Requirements.GoldPathMissing: Gold cost is enabled, but no supported gold path was found on this actor.
MKSDC.Notifications.NoActor: No actor found. Select a token or assign a character.
MKSDC.Notifications.NoActorPermission: You do not have permission to craft with this actor.
MKSDC.Notifications.PlayerCraftingDisabl: Player crafting is disabled by the GM.
MKSDC.Notifications.OutputCreateFailed: The crafting roll succeeded, but the output item could not be created.
MKSDC.Notifications.GMOnly: Only a GM can do that.
MKSDC.Notifications.CompendiumRecipeRead: Compendium recipes are read-only. Import the item first to edit it.
MKSDC.Settings.ShowActorSheetButton.Name: Show actor sheet crafting button
MKSDC.Settings.ShowActorSheetButton.Hint: Adds a Crafting button to actor sheet headers.
MKSDC.Settings.ShowSceneControl.Name: Show token control crafting button
MKSDC.Settings.ShowSceneControl.Hint: Adds a hammer button to the token controls.
MKSDC.Settings.AllowPlayerCrafting.Name: Allow player crafting
MKSDC.Settings.AllowPlayerCrafting.Hint: If disabled, only GMs can perform crafting attempts.
MKSDC.Settings.ConsumeMaterialsOnFailure: A failed crafting check consumes half of the recipe materials.
MKSDC.Settings.CriticalFailureLosesAll.H: On a natural 1, consume all required materials instead of half.
MKSDC.Settings.CriticalSuccessHalfCost.H: On a natural 20, consume only half of the materials and gold cost.
MKSDC.Settings.UseGoldCost.Name: Use gold cost
MKSDC.Settings.UseGoldCost.Hint: If enabled, recipes with gold costs try to deduct gold from supported actor currency paths.
MKSDC.Settings.CheckTools.Name: Check required tools
MKSDC.Settings.CheckTools.Hint: If enabled, required tools must exist as owned items on the actor.
MKSDC.Settings.CheckStations.Name: Check required stations
MKSDC.Settings.CheckStations.Hint: If enabled, required stations must exist as owned items on the actor.
If enabled, item compendiums are scanned for recipe items. This can be slower.
MKSDC.Settings.RecipeCompendiumFilter.Hi: Optional comma-separated text filter for compendium collection names or labels.
MKSDC.Settings.RecipeItemType.Name: Legacy recipe item type
MKSDC.Settings.RecipeItemType.Hint: Hidden legacy fallback. New recipes use the output item type.
MKSDC.Settings.Debug.Name: Debug logging
MKSDC.Settings.Debug.Hint: Print extra module information to the browser console.
MKSDC.Editor.OutputDropHint: Drop the item this recipe creates here. The recipe item will use this output name, image, and type.
MKSDC.Editor.OutputManualHint: Manual output item. The recipe item will use these output values.
MKSDC.Editor.UseOutputName: Use output name as recipe item name
MKSDC.Editor.MaterialDropHint: Drop an item here to add a new material requirement row.
MKSDC.Editor.NoMaterials: No input materials yet. Drop items here or add a manual row.
MKSDC.Notifications.DroppedItemNotFound: The dropped item could not be found.
MKSDC.Notifications.RecipeTypeSyncFailed: The recipe item name and image were saved, but Foundry did not allow changing the item type. Create a new recipe if the item type must change.
MKSDC.Editor.GroupTypeHint: Controls the group name in the left recipe tree. Leave it as the output type or enter a custom group such as Medicine, Survival, or Alchemy.
MKSDC.Dialog.DeleteRecipeContent: Delete recipe {name}? This cannot be undone.
MKSDC.Editor.Name: Name
MKSDC.Editor.AlternativeDropHint: Drop a substitute item here, or add a manual substitute.
MKSDC.Editor.SubstitutesHintShort: One of these alternatives is required.
MKSDC.Editor.AbilitiesHint: Choose which abilities can be used for this recipe. The crafter chooses one when crafting.
MKSDC.Dialog.RollModeHint: Choose the ability, then roll with advantage, normal, or disadvantage.
MKSDC.RecipeBooks.ImportModeMerge: Merge - update recipes from this book when possible
MKSDC.RecipeBooks.ImportModeCreate: Create copies - always create new recipes
MKSDC.RecipeBooks.SaveHint: Saves the currently active recipes as a new recipe book snapshot in this world.
MKSDC.RecipeBooks.ExportHint: Exports the selected recipe book as a JSON file.
MKSDC.RecipeBooks.ImportHint: Imports a recipe book JSON file into this world. Imported books are stored in module settings, not the Items Directory.
MKSDC.Notifications.NoRecipeBookFile: Choose a recipe book JSON file first.
MKSDC.Notifications.RecipeBookImportFail: Recipe book import failed. Check the console for details.
MKSDC.RecipeBooks.ManagerHint: Recipe books are stored in this world. Active books appear in the Crafting UI. Export them as JSON to move them to another world.
MKSDC.RecipeBooks.NoSavedBooks: No recipe books yet. Import a book, save the active recipes, or create a recipe.
MKSDC.RecipeBooks.ApplyHint: Activates this recipe book so its recipes appear in the Crafting UI.
MKSDC.RecipeBooks.UpdateContent: Refresh and normalize recipes stored in the recipe book {name}?
MKSDC.RecipeBooks.DeleteContent: Delete the recipe book {name}? This deletes recipes stored in that book.
MKSDC.Notifications.NoImportFile: Choose a recipe book JSON file first.
MKSDC.Notifications.LegacyRecipesMigrate: Migrated {count} recipes into {name}. Old recipe items were left untouched.
MKSDC.RecipeBooks.ActiveHint: Active books appear in the Crafting UI.
MKSDC.RecipeBooks.MigrateContent: Copy old item-based recipes into a new active recipe book. The old Item Directory recipes will not be deleted.
MKSDC.Editor.CategoryHint: Controls the group name in the left recipe tree. Leave it as the output type or enter a custom group such as Medicine, Survival, or Alchemy.
MKSDC.Settings.LayoutMode.Name: Crafting UI Layout
MKSDC.Settings.LayoutMode.Hint: Preferred layout for the crafting interface.
MKSDC.App.ResourceSourcesHint: Checked actors are searched and consumed in this order.
MKSDC.Deconstruct.Title: Deconstruct {name}
MKSDC.Deconstruct.Content: Remove one {name} and recover half of the materials from recipe {recipe}, rounded up. No skill roll is required.
MKSDC.Deconstruct.NoRecipe: No deconstruct recipe was found for this item.
MKSDC.Deconstruct.CouldNotRemoveItem: Could not remove the item to deconstruct it.
MKSDC.Deconstruct.NoOwnedItem: {actor} does not have a deconstructable {item} in their inventory.
MKSDC.Deconstruct.InventoryHint: Choose an owned item that has a deconstruct recipe. No skill roll is required.
MKSDC.Deconstruct.NoInventoryItems: No owned items with a deconstruct recipe were found on this actor.
MKSDC.Deconstruct.NoSearchResults: No items with a deconstruct recipe match this search.
MKSDC.Deconstruct.NoRecipeHint: This item is shown from the actor inventory, but it cannot be deconstructed because no active or saved recipe creates it.
MKSDC.Editor.DeconstructDropHint: Drop materials recovered when this item is deconstructed.
MKSDC.Editor.DeconstructMaterialsHint: These are the materials returned by Deconstruct mode. If left empty, the module creates a default deconstruct recipe from half the craft materials, rounded up.
MKSDC.Editor.NoDeconstructMaterials: No deconstruct materials yet. Drop items here or leave empty to auto-generate from craft materials on save.
